participants.note: reported Windows CI failure and suggested converting to draft
pointed out the failing WalletMigration benchmark in CI
provided Code review ACK, but raised concerns about pre-checking writability and exception safety
pointed out throwing instead of returning error bypassed migration cleanup
pinged author to rebase and address review feedback

claims.harm: Checking path writability introduces TOCTOU risks, duplicates write logic, and masks error reporting
claims.quote: I’d advise against the approach in the last two commits of checking whether paths are writable before writing, rather than handling write failures directly.
claims.settled_by_quote: Initial concern i had earlier about trying to predict whether paths were writable is resolved and well handled.

claims.harm: Throwing an exception in MigrateToSQLite bypasses failed migration cleanup
claims.quote: Why throw instead of returning an error? MigrateToSQLite already bypasses failed migration cleanup.
claims.settled_by_quote: Changed it to return an error instead.

claims.harm: Filesystem operations could throw or leave temporary wallet directories on failure
claims.quote: This function returns util::Result but contains a lot of filesystem calls that can throw exceptions
claims.settled_by_quote: Ended up dropping the function entirely. We don't need such machinery.

support.reason: The last commit provides a potentially significant benefit because it delays deleting the original wallet database until the new sqlite database is fully created

result.notes: Recorded resolved objections from ryanofsky on TOCTOU pre-checks and filesystem exception handling, and from achow101 on error handling during migration cleanup. Ryanofsky provided a Code review ACK.
